title: Moving heads, a File menu and a pop-out preview
items: Moving heads: a Moving head effect (pattern, size, aim, speed, spread between heads, brightness, colours) that xLights renders with its own Moving Head effect. Tested in an xLights render.
Moving heads are drawn in the preview as fixtures with beams that sweep in their colour.

Moving heads box: choose which parts of the song the heads join, add or re-roll just the heads without touching anything else, and set how big they look in the preview. Each part also has + Moving heads.
Ideas and 🎲 Randomize include moving heads: slow, small shapes in quiet parts, big fast ones in loud parts.
File menu: open a song or project, recent projects, Save, Save as, Auto-save and Export, like any program. The project's name shows beside it, with a • while there are unsaved changes.
⤓ Export to xLights (Ctrl+E): one dialog to save the .xsq into your show folder or download it.
⧉ Pop out: the preview in its own window, handy on a second screen.
Step tracker under the tabs: Song › Words › Your show › Plan the lights › Export, ticking off as you go.
What's new (this list) and when the website was last updated.
Matrices get a layered look (a base plus a lighter effect on top), and big singing props like a snow globe get a background with the face on top.
Round props (snowflakes, spinners, wreaths, stars) share each other's moves, and names like "ChromaFlake" count as snowflakes.
Image props are drawn as their picture, glowing in the light's colour.
Moving heads set to "No Controller" in xLights were skipped by ideas and Randomize.

title: Tester feedback round: guide, projects, transitions and more
items: How to use guide and a Show me around tour in the app.
More prop types in the preview: circles, icicles, candy canes, spinners, wreaths, spheres, multi-point and channel blocks, and older xLights files.
Prop types…: tell ideas what a prop is when its name doesn't say.
Projects: recent projects to switch between, a projects folder, and Save / Don't save / Cancel before switching. Auto-save.
📝 Words on the matrix: put the sung words on your matrix in the parts you choose.
Only the part that's playing: the plan shows just the part you hear and follows the song.
The control boxes above the plan can be folded and rearranged (unlock the layout first).
Each part shows how it comes in (ramp up, sweep in, burst, colour hit, crossfade…) and you can change it.
Discord link for ideas, bugs and help.
Going into a chorus no longer goes dark and flashes white every time: each lift gets its own transition.
A new start screen, and the controls above the plan grouped into Ideas, Change what's planned and View.
Same look for parts with the same name is off by default, with a clearer explanation.
Opening a project kept asking where the MP3 is: now one click (and Chrome/Edge can allow it on every visit).
Props that aren't in your show (from another layout, or renamed) are never written into the sequence; a note offers to swap them.
Suggest a plan crashed on props whose type couldn't be guessed.

title: First public version
items: Load an MP3: tempo, beats, bars, song parts, loud and quiet sections and drum hits are found for you.
Find the words: voice separation and speech recognition, matched to your lyrics, for singing faces and timing tracks.
Open your xLights show folder and watch the plan on a preview of your own house.
Suggest a plan and 🎲 Randomize, with feeling, intensity, colour schemes, prop mix and props to leave out.
Lights that follow the music: louder parts brighter and fuller, the beat on one or two props, build-ups into choruses, and a fit-with-the-music score.
Save projects, and export an .xsq for xLights with Beats, Bars, Song Parts and Lyrics timing tracks.
Free and open source (GPLv3). Everything runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
